summary: Sigma Lithium Corp filed a Form 6-K on July 15, 2026, reporting the results of its Annual Shareholder Meeting held June 30, 2026. Shareholders elected or re-elected all five director nominees with over 96% support, including CEO Ana Cabral with 97.4% of votes. A total of 81,553,499 common shares (72.77% of outstanding) were voted. The filing also highlights company expansion plans, including Phase 2 construction to increase lithium concentrate production to 520,000 tonnes per year. This is a routine annual meeting report with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, activist campaign, or management change. The Form 6-K serves as a foreign private issuer report of meeting results.
